member_home.label: Your day at [service]
member_home.purpose: For a returning member of a recurring service — yoga studio, gym, salon, coworking, subscription box, fitness app. Opens with the next moment they care about.

operator_console.label: Ops floor · now
operator_console.purpose: For a person running live operations right now — dispatcher, charge nurse, restaurant expediter, network operator. Density is a feature. Silence is broken by alerts.

creator_workspace.label: Studio · today's draft
creator_workspace.purpose: For someone making a thing — writer, designer, video editor, PM drafting a spec. The current work fills the screen; navigation and metrics stay ambient.

manager_overview.label: Team pulse
manager_overview.purpose: For someone accountable for a group — sales manager, school principal, engineering lead. Opens with the team's state, not the manager's tasks.

field_worker_today.label: Route
field_worker_today.purpose: For someone doing physical work in the world — delivery driver, technician, home-health worker, inspector. Big targets, high contrast, one-thing-at-a-time.

shopper_home.label: For you
shopper_home.purpose: For a browsing customer — commerce, marketplace, catalog. Opens with a curated moment and reasons-to-return.

learner_home.label: Continue
learner_home.purpose: For someone on a learning journey — language app, cooking course, MOOC, professional cert. Opens with resume-where-left-off.

analyst_workspace.label: Read
analyst_workspace.purpose: For someone interpreting data for others — marketing analyst, ops analyst, journalist, researcher. Headline metric with a sentence of narrative, then drill-downs.

patron_events.label: On the calendar
patron_events.purpose: For someone who buys tickets, follows artists, attends events — venue, sports team, festival, theater.

citizen_service.label: Your status
citizen_service.purpose: For someone interacting with a public service — permit, benefit, license, tax, court date. Opens with 'here is where your case is', never a form dashboard.

catalog_grid.label: Browse the catalog
catalog_grid.purpose: For image-primary browsing — shopping catalog, media library, portfolio, template gallery. Cards are the unit; text is subordinate.

admin_table.label: All [records]
admin_table.purpose: For dense-record management — invoices, users, orders, tickets. Sortable columns, bulk selection, row action menus.

kanban_board.label: By status
kanban_board.purpose: For work-in-flight visualisation — deals, candidates, tickets, tasks. Columns are statuses; cards flow across.

timeline_stream.label: What's happening
timeline_stream.purpose: For chronological activity — social feed, notification list, audit log, event stream. Grouped by day, newest first.

map_list.label: On the map
map_list.purpose: For geo-anchored listings — rentals, jobs near you, store locator. List on one side, map on the other; selection syncs.

search_results.label: Results for [query]
search_results.purpose: For universal or cross-entity search. Mixed result types with type badges. Facets on the side. Empty-state helper when nothing matches.

product_detail.label: This item
product_detail.purpose: For anything for sale — commerce, marketplace, ticketing. Gallery is huge. Price stack and variant picker are close. Primary CTA is unmissable.

record_detail.label: This [record]
record_detail.purpose: For an admin/CRM record — a contact, an invoice, a ticket, a case file. Header carries key metadata + status; body has tabs.

profile_public.label: About this person
profile_public.purpose: For a person's public presence — user profile, artist page, author page, teacher spotlight.

article_reader.label: This story
article_reader.purpose: For long-form reading — blog post, news article, docs page, help article. Typography is the design.

media_player.label: Watch / listen
media_player.purpose: For video, podcast, audio class. The player is the whole point — biggest surface, minimal chrome.

create_entity.label: New [thing]
create_entity.purpose: For a fresh record. All fields blank, grouped by section. Sticky footer with cancel + submit. Required marks. Live validation.

edit_entity.label: Edit [thing]
edit_entity.purpose: Same bones as create but fields pre-filled, header names the record, footer adds discard/delete. Dirty-state tracking.

wizard_multistep.label: Guided flow
wizard_multistep.purpose: For long forms broken into steps — application, tax filing, complex booking. Step indicator top, one stage at a time.

settings_tabbed.label: Your settings
settings_tabbed.purpose: For configuration with categories — account, notifications, integrations, billing. Vertical tab rail, per-tab save.

filter_builder.label: Refine
filter_builder.purpose: For advanced query construction — saved reports, complex search, list refinement. Stack of constraint rows; live preview count.

onboarding.label: Get started
onboarding.purpose: For first-time user setup. Welcome + why. Progress dots. Skippable steps. Ends with a first-value moment.

checkout.label: Almost done
checkout.purpose: For commerce checkout. Order summary visible throughout. Shipping → payment → review. Trust markers around pay button.

approval.label: Your call
approval.purpose: For a single approve/reject decision — expense, PR, leave request, content moderation. Two verbs, no clutter.

upload_and_process.label: Working on it
upload_and_process.purpose: For upload-then-process flows — scan a product, OCR a doc, transcribe audio, run a batch.

empty_state.label: Nothing yet
empty_state.purpose: For a list or dashboard with zero rows. Illustration + one honest sentence + the CTA that would populate this.

error_page.label: Something broke
error_page.purpose: For 500/generic failure. Plain-language explanation. Recovery actions. No blame; no theatrics.

offline.label: You're offline
offline.purpose: For lost network state. Signal icon. What still works (cached content). Retry when back.

success_confirm.label: Done
success_confirm.purpose: For after a successful action. Confirmation + what happens next + one clear next-step CTA.

loading_wait.label: Working…
loading_wait.purpose: For long-running server operations — export, batch job, AI inference. Progress + status + ETA + cancel.

permission_denied.label: Not for you
permission_denied.purpose: For 403/access-denied. Lock icon. Why blocked (role, plan, invite-only). Path forward.

task_inbox.label: Your tasks
task_inbox.purpose: For a user's queue of assigned work — approvals, form fills, reviews. Count in header. Overdue pinned to top.

task_detail.label: This task
task_detail.purpose: For a single user_task from a workflow. Task context header. Complete/reject bar sticky. History sidebar for audit.

workflow_run_trace.label: Run trace
workflow_run_trace.purpose: For debugging/audit of a workflow execution. Every node's status + timing. Inputs/outputs per node.

notification_center.label: Notifications
notification_center.purpose: For the all-notifications view — mentions, updates, system messages. Category tabs, grouped by day.

hail_ride_map.label: Where to?
hail_ride_map.purpose: For the request-a-ride/delivery start screen. Full-screen map with user location pinned, destination-search sheet, fare estimate.

ride_in_progress.label: On the way
ride_in_progress.purpose: For the live-tracking state during a ride/delivery. Map with driver moving. ETA prominent. Message/call one tap away.

live_tracking_status.label: Where's my order
live_tracking_status.purpose: For package/shipment/delivery tracking without a live driver — Amazon 'arriving today', food delivery countdown.

service_launcher.label: What do you need
service_launcher.purpose: For superapp home — one app, many verticals. Ride, food, package, groceries. Yango, Grab, DoorDash bundles.

lesson_viewer.label: Watch and learn
lesson_viewer.purpose: For a single lesson — video + transcript + notes + next-lesson. Player dominates. Progress bar remembers position.

exercise_workflow.label: Try it
exercise_workflow.purpose: For a practice exercise — question, answer options, submit, correctness feedback, next. Duolingo, Khan practice.

certificate_page.label: You did it
certificate_page.purpose: For the completion moment — certificate, badge, milestone. Ceremony is the point: medal centered, name, course, date.

resource_calendar.label: Who's when
resource_calendar.purpose: For rows-of-resources × columns-of-time with booking bars. Team leave, meeting rooms, hospital beds, interviewer availability.

timesheet_grid.label: Log your hours
timesheet_grid.purpose: For matrix entry — rows are projects/tasks, columns are days, cells are hours. Classic timesheet.

event_calendar_month.label: This month
event_calendar_month.purpose: For the traditional 7-column month grid with event dots/bars. Google-Calendar-style.
